Upstream:
- [GitHub Desktop 3.7.0 release notes](https://github.com/desktop/desktop/releases/tag/release-3.7.0)
- [GitHub Desktop 3.7.1-beta1 release notes](https://github.com/desktop/desktop/releases/tag/release-3.7.1-beta1)

## Changes and improvements:

- [#318] The commit history graph view now prioritizes commit names over dates. Thanks @3vorp!

- [#319] Collapse and wrap the branch/tag list on small sidebars in the history graph view. Thanks @3vorp!

- [#320] The commit history graph view now respects your choice of absolute vs relative dates.

## Fixes:

- [#321] Fixed misaligned elements in the file tree view. Thanks @3vorp!

- [#326] When the Changes tab filter box is hidden, the changes tab header is now slightly taller to make it consistent with the other tabs. Thanks @3vorp!

- [#325] Fixed a regression that caused the "Normalize Copied Paths" setting to be ignored.

- [#329] The "Resolve conflicts before Merge" dialog now displays the correct editor name in the "Open in..." buttons.
